description: One story by slug (YYYY-MM-DD-slug); include=["content"] returns the full markdown body.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

include.description: Pass ["content"] to inline the full body (Pro). Omitted, you get the summary.

slug.description: Post slug — date-prefixed, as find_posts returns it, e.g. "2026-09-29-you-cannot-see-your-own-api-from-the-outside".

name: get_post
